rewrites.//: The live Render service. Render appends random characters when a service name is already taken globally, so this is NOT simply render.yaml's service name - copy it from the Render dashboard. Verify with <host>/health, which should answer {status:ok,db:connected}. Proxying rather than calling the backend cross-origin is what keeps the refresh cookie first-party: same origin, SameSite=Lax, no third-party cookie blocking.
